questions.q: ECI's Special Summary Revision (SSR) announced on 6 Nov 2026 covers electoral rolls for how many States/UTs where SIR is already complete?
questions.explanation: The SSR covers 6 States/UTs — Arunachal Pradesh, Mizoram, Odisha, Sikkim, Chandigarh, and Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu.

questions.q: Activists Anjali Bhardwaj and Amrita Johri sought FIRs over alleged forgery of which form in Delhi's Mustafabad SIR process?
questions.explanation: They alleged forgery of Form 7 (objection form) filings and sought a full audit.

questions.q: ECI restored oversight of which wing, reversing a July order, after two Election Commissioners objected?
questions.explanation: ECI restored oversight of its IT wing (headed by Seema Khanna) under a Deputy Election Commissioner.

questions.q: Elaborating its 'arrest begins at detention' ruling, the SC held a Magistrate must record what, when a person is produced after 24 hours?
questions.explanation: The Magistrate must record the actual time of detention; only travel time to court is excluded from the 24-hour count.

questions.q: Where did an unauthorised building collapse on 6 Nov 2026, killing 2 — Delhi's 3rd such collapse since 6 September?
questions.explanation: The 3-storey unauthorised building collapsed in old Delhi's Chawri Bazar; Delhi Police had flagged the illegal construction since 15 June.

questions.q: Per the Hindu editorial, roughly how many sanitation workers died on sewer/septic-tank jobs in India between 2014 and 2025?
questions.explanation: 859 sanitation workers died on sewer/septic-tank duty (2014-2025); 332 of these were across 18 States/UTs between 2021-26.

questions.q: DRDO flight-tested which indigenous quasi-ballistic missile from Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam Island in a user-evaluation trial?
questions.explanation: Pralay is an indigenous quasi-ballistic missile; the successful trial clears the way for its induction into the armed forces.

questions.q: Under the clarified Agnipath scheme, Agniveers not retained after 4 years get what option, before joining the regular cadre?
questions.explanation: The 75% not retained after 4 years get a second 2-year engagement; willing and fit Agniveers can then join the regular cadre with protected seniority.

questions.q: CERT-In named 'Crafty Falcon', a hacking group linked to which country, using AI tools to breach Indian fintechs and crypto exchanges?
questions.explanation: Crafty Falcon is linked to China; it used AI tools (ARTEX, PentAGI, Cairn, CyberStrikeAI) to breach targets 'at machine speed'.

questions.q: NPCI told the SC the new UPI Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) of 0.4% applies to Person-to-Merchant transactions above what amount?
questions.explanation: The 0.4% MDR applies only to P2M transactions above ₹2,000 — about 4% of merchant transactions; P2P and small P2M stay free.

questions.q: CERT-In's new 'AI Security Auditing Guidelines' specifically target which kind of AI system?
options: Agentic AI that plans tasks and delegates work
questions.explanation: The guidelines target agentic AI systems that plan tasks, use tools and delegate work on their own, calling for audits of permission overreach.

questions.q: ISRO's navigation satellite NVS-03 reached circular orbit after its engine fired for how long?
questions.explanation: NVS-03's engine fired for 6,400 seconds to reach circular orbit; ISRO chief V. Narayanan confirmed it is 'fully healthy'.

questions.q: NPPA capped trade margins at 30% on how many non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs, cutting prices of nearly 900 brands?
questions.explanation: 137 non-scheduled anti-cancer drugs got the 30% trade-margin cap, cutting prices of nearly 900 brands by 70-93%; but 194 of 1,024 analysed brands saw no cut.

questions.q: A Nature Medicine study of 6.1 million people across 118 countries found women report higher pain than men at how many body sites studied?
questions.explanation: Women reported more pain than men at all 11 body sites studied — 83% higher for facial pain, 74% for headaches.

questions.q: The UGC regulations under SC review, stayed in January 2026 as 'too sweeping', deal with equity in which area?
questions.explanation: The UGC (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations, 2026 were stayed by the SC; the older 2012 Regulations continue to apply.

questions.q: Census 2027's door-to-door enumeration begins 1 December in which kind of States, using the CMMS app for real-time tracking?
questions.explanation: Census 2027, India's first fully digital Census, begins door-to-door enumeration on 1 December in poll-bound UP, Uttarakhand, Punjab and Goa, tracked via the CMMS app.

questions.q: Which Israeli figure did the Arab-majority Joint List and Ra'am back to form the next government, bypassing PM Netanyahu?
questions.explanation: Joint List (11 seats) and Ra'am (8 seats) backed Gadi Eisenkot; President Isaac Herzog will give the mandate to form a government.

questions.q: Where did Iran report two more tankers and a tugboat catching fire on 6 Nov 2026?
questions.explanation: Iran reported the fires in the Strait of Hormuz; the UK's UKMTO separately reported a tanker hit by projectiles off Qatar.

questions.q: On US midterm day, President Trump announced the US will stop roughly how much in annual military aid to Israel?
questions.explanation: Trump announced the US will stop its roughly $4-billion annual military aid to Israel by year-end, citing political costs after a candidate's anti-aid plank helped flip Michigan.

questions.q: US Vice-President J.D. Vance blamed which factor for the Republican midterm defeat, positioning himself for 2028?
questions.explanation: Vance said 'the reason we lost is the war', blaming the Iran war for the midterm defeat and positioning himself as 2028 front-runner.

questions.q: India beat Japan 4-1 in the Asian Champions Trophy hockey final in Mohali — this was India's how many-th ACT title in 7 editions?
questions.explanation: India retained the title for its 6th ACT crown in 7 editions; Hardik Singh played his 200th international match in the tournament.

questions.q: Cristiano Ronaldo retired from international football as Portugal's all-time scorer with how many goals?
questions.explanation: Ronaldo (41) retired with a world-record 146 goals in 234 matches for Portugal.

questions.q: In the Delhi-Services Ranji Group-C draw, which Services batter scored 142 to power the innings?
questions.explanation: Mohit Ahlawat scored 142 and Rajat Paliwal 116 for Services; Yash Dhull's 104* helped Delhi survive chasing 320.

questions.q: Chennai Super Kings traded for Liam Livingstone and Jack Edwards ahead of IPL 2027, giving up which two bowlers?
questions.explanation: CSK gave up pacers Khaleel Ahmed and Nathan Ellis in the trade — the team's first trade under new coach Zaheer Khan.

questions.q: As per the SC's ruling (Justice Ujjal Bhuyan), when does the 24-hour clock under Article 22(2) begin for a detained person?
options: From the time charges are framed
From the time of formal arrest after paperwork
The moment an official touches the person to restrain their liberty
questions.explanation: Justice Ujjal Bhuyan held that 'detention' cannot be separated from 'arrest' — the clock starts the moment an official touches a person to restrain their liberty, not from formal arrest.

questions.q: A tokamak confines fusion plasma mainly using:
questions.explanation: The concept, from Soviet physicists Tamm and Sakharov, confines plasma magnetically in a ring; India's tokamaks (ADITYA/ADITYA-U, SST-1) are at Gandhinagar.
